title: What's New: Enhanced MCP Server (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Import Export and Multiple MCP Hosts

features.name: MCP Configuration Validations
features.description: Validates whether MCP configuration is still valid when APIs or queries are added or removed. Provides warnings when parent APIs are missing and offers automatic recommended actions.

features.name: Configuration Import Export
features.description: Allows exporting a configuration to JSON on one environment and importing it to another environment. Enables safe deployment of configurations across test, pre-production and production environments.

features.name: Support for Multiple MCP Hosts
features.description: Business Central MCP server now supports other MCP hosts beyond Microsoft Copilot Studio. Microsoft Copilot Studio is the fully supported host; other hosts like VS Code are in public preview.
features.status_evidence_quote: Other hosts would be in public preview and not kind of fully supported
caveats: VS Code requires pre-authorization; other hosts may need additional setup like intra application registration

features.name: Connection String Setup
features.description: New connection string feature under advanced settings that provides exact configuration needed to connect MCP clients to Business Central. Simplifies setup for cloud or VS Code clients.
caveats: VS Code is pre-authorized; other hosts may require additional setup

features.name: MCP Configuration Telemetry
features.description: All MCP configuration changes are logged to Microsoft audit logs as auditable events. Also includes telemetry on MCP calls - both successful and failed - allowing monitoring of agent health and usage.
caveats: MCP host type logging may be limited for hosts where HTTP headers cannot be fully trusted

features.name: MCP Resources Support
features.description: Business Central MCP server now supports the MCP resources protocol feature added months ago. Enables MCP hosts to use code execution and handle large amounts of data more efficiently.
caveats: Resources are optional; existing MCP implementations continue to work without changes

features.name: Embedded Resources
features.description: MCP server returns large data sets as embedded file references instead of text content blocks. Allows MCP hosts to pass file references to code execution tools for data analysis without inflating model context.
caveats: Code execution happens on MCP host side, not Business Central side; requires code interpreter to be enabled
